prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity desktop web app UI design frame, a completely flat front-on screen, no browser chrome, no device, no perspective, no presentation background. Canvas 1440 x 1000 (landscape ratio 1.44). App name SIDEQUEST, a simulated family savings dashboard for a teenager. This is design exploration, not code. Cozy hybrid aesthetic: warm ivory #F5F2E9 main canvas, deep forest #233F35 sidebar and primary buttons, sage #A9BA96, muted gold #D6AD58, charcoal #24312B. Very polished, clean financial dashboard with restrained original pixel art. Lots of breathing room and fine subtle borders, 10px radius cards. Pixel lettering ONLY logo, main quest heading, tiny milestone labels; clean modern sans-serif everywhere else including all numbers. Small crisp outlined icons. Never sacrifice text legibility for the pixel effect. No copied game artwork.

Layout precisely: 208px-wide forest-green left sidebar full height; main canvas 1232px wide with generous 36px margins. Sidebar top pixel sprout or small flag mark and word SIDEQUEST in cream, small subtitle 'Small saves. Big adventures.' Navigation with icons: 'Overview' active on muted lighter green background, 'Activity', 'How it works'. Bottom sidebar small inset cream-on-green tip reading 'Little by little adds up.' and a 'Demo money' pill. Main top header greeting 'Hey, Alex' with small eyebrow 'YOUR SAVINGS ADVENTURE'. At top right a Teen / Parent segmented control with Teen selected, plus small square avatar.

Main content: heading 'Your next adventure' with a small pixel sparkle. A wide hero goal card spans ~765px and a narrower wallet card ~330px to its right. Goal card top area cream with eyebrow 'ACTIVE QUEST', large heading 'PS5 Quest', '$399.30' large readable sans, inline 'of $500.00', and pill '80% saved'. Upper right inside goal card a tiny edit icon. Goal card lower illustration: a beautiful horizontal original cozy 8-bit/pixel-art forest clearing, layered sage pines, golden afternoon sky, a winding footpath with a few gold coins toward a little treasure chest and a white game console silhouette. Landscape confined to hero about 180px tall, not full screen. Below art a segmented sage/gold horizontal progress bar; labels '25%', '50%', '75%', 'FINISH'; first three reached, finish outlined. Footer '$100.70 to go' left; forest primary button 'Add to savings' and quiet outlined 'Withdraw' right.

Right wallet card heading 'Your wallet', simple pixel coin icon, '$125.00' large, 'Available to move into savings', outlined button '+ Add demo funds'. Under it another right card 'Next monthly boost', '+$39.93' forest green large, small '+10% / MONTH' gold pill, explanatory copy '10% of your $399.30 savings, paid by your parent.' small plain label 'Parent fund: Covered'.

Lower section: large card left 'Watch your savings grow', small 'Balance over simulated months', clean accessible line chart with 4 accurate increasing points labeled Start $300, M1 $330, M2 $363, M3 $399.30; forest green line with sage area, ivory background, thin grid, no forecasts. Chart footer tiny metrics 'Deposited $300.00' 'Withdrawn $0.00' 'Interest earned $99.30'. Right lower card 'Recent activity' with 3 rows: 'Monthly interest +$36.30 / Month 3', 'Monthly interest +$33.00 / Month 2', 'Monthly interest +$30.00 / Month 1'. Bottom across main content a slim forest-tinted simulation control strip with 'SIMULATION', 'Month 3', 'Paused', forest 'Play' button, '10s / month' speed selector and small inactive 'Next month in 10s'. Footer subtle 'Simulated money · Parent-funded learning rate'. Entire UI fits canvas, no cropped content. No XP, no level score, no fake payments, no unrelated navigation, no gibberish. Render exact currency values. Professional visual hierarchy: savings first, transfer second, explanatory chart third.

Use case: ui-mockup. Edit the supplied SIDEQUEST teen dashboard into its Add to savings dialog state. The supplied image is the edit target and exact visual reference. Preserve the SAME entire dashboard, cream canvas, forest-green sidebar, pixel forest banner, typography, account avatar, component sizes and arrangement, all background balances and numbers, canvas aspect ratio. Create one flat front-on high fidelity screen only. Desired export design size 1440x1000. Add a subtle dark forest translucent scrim over the entire existing dashboard, enough for context to remain recognizable but make dialog foreground legible.

Place one exquisitely clean warm ivory dialog centered in the MAIN content area (not sidebar), roughly 560px wide and 590px tall. 12px corners, fine taupe border and soft shadow. Small pixel gold coin at top left of dialog and X close button top right. Title in clean sans serif 'Give your quest a boost'. Subtext 'Move money from your wallet into savings.' A small horizontal flow strip: 'Your wallet' then arrow then 'PS5 savings'. Label 'Amount to move', a large bordered input with '$50.00'. Four shortcuts '$10' '$25' '$50' 'Max', with $50 selected forest green. A pale sage preview panel headed 'After this transfer' with TWO perfectly readable rows: 'Your wallet' '$125.00 → $75.00'; 'PS5 savings' '$399.30 → $449.30'. Below: 'Your next monthly interest would be $44.93.' Then a full-width forest primary button with cream readable text 'Move $50 to savings'. Quiet 'Cancel' below. Tiny footer 'Demo transfer · No real money moves'. Ensure all text is exactly spelled, each value legible, amount $50 not $500. No extra illustration inside dialog. Pixel detail restrained and all money typography smooth sans serif. Background should remain same Month 3 $399.30 savings $125 wallet $39.93 next interest, since this is a pre-confirmation preview. Do not change original artwork or original sidebar. No browser chrome, no device mockup, no cropped canvas.

Use case: ui-mockup. Edit the supplied SIDEQUEST teen dashboard into its Month 6 goal-reached state. The supplied image is the edit target and exact visual reference. Preserve the same flat front-on layout, forest sidebar with sprout SIDEQUEST logo, ivory canvas, card positions, clean typography, teen selected top toggle, avatar, forest/gold/sage palette, original pixel forest art style and canvas aspect ratio. Desired export design size 1440x1000.

Change only content/state to this later moment:
Top header still 'Hey, Alex'. Replace main heading with pixel heading 'Quest complete. PS5 unlocked!' fitting without cramped text. Main goal card eyebrow 'QUEST COMPLETE', heading 'PS5 Quest', large savings '$531.47' and inline 'of $500.00', badge 'Goal reached'. Keep same illustrated forest but now the treasure chest is fully open with restrained gold pixel sparkles and console alongside. No full-screen confetti. Progress bar fully filled forest/sage with all four milestones ticked (25%,50%,75%,FINISH).
Goal card footer dominant forest button 'Buy PS5 · Demo purchase', and small note '$31.47 goes back to your wallet'. Remove Add to savings and Withdraw because goal complete. Buying has not happened yet.

Right upper card remains 'Your wallet', '$125.00', 'Available for your next adventure', '+ Add demo funds'.
Right lower card replaces next-interest panel with 'Ready when you are', small pixel gift icon, clear rows 'Saved $531.47', 'Purchase price $500.00', 'Left over $31.47'. Short note 'Interest has stopped because you reached your goal.'

Lower chart heading 'Look how far you came', clean forest savings curve with actual 7 points Start 300, M1 330, M2 363, M3 399.30, M4 439.23, M5 483.15, M6 531.47. Fit readable chart labels especially final '$531.47'. Footer metric values 'Deposited $300.00', 'Withdrawn $0.00', 'Interest earned $231.47'. Right activity card rows 'Monthly interest +$48.32 / Month 6', 'Monthly interest +$43.92 / Month 5', 'Monthly interest +$39.93 / Month 4'. Bottom simulation strip 'SIMULATION', 'Month 6', 'Goal reached', disabled Play control and 'Paused'. Very bottom 'Simulated money · Parent-funded learning rate'. All dollar amounts exact. Keep layout clean and readable; all contents within screen; no extra game levels or XP; no browser chrome or presentation framing.

Use case: ui-mockup. Transform supplied SIDEQUEST teen dashboard into the corresponding PARENT dashboard. Supplied image is edit target and exact shared-brand/layout reference. Preserve forest-green #233F35 sidebar, warm ivory #F5F2E9 canvas, sage accents #A9BA96, muted gold #D6AD58, same spacing, thin taupe card borders, roughly10px corners, restrained clean sans typography, same canvas aspect ratio. Desired export design size1440x1000. One flat front-on high fidelity full UI screen, no device or browser chrome.

Adult parent experience: mature, calm, no pixel landscape, NO pixel avatar, NO treasure scene, NO quest labels, NO confetti, NO game milestones. Keep only tiny pixel sprout SIDEQUEST logo as shared brand. Sidebar logo subtitle change to 'Helping their savings grow.' Navigation icons 'Overview' active, 'Activity', 'How it works'. Bottom sidebar plain information 'Parent-funded savings' and 'Demo money' label.

Main top left eyebrow 'PARENT DASHBOARD', main greeting 'Family overview'. Top right Teen/Parent segmented toggle with Parent selected, simple initials avatar 'JD'. Thin divider. First section heading 'Alex’s savings, at a glance'. Under heading full-width compact goal summary panel, label 'SAVINGS GOAL', title 'PlayStation 5', big '$399.30' inline 'of $500.00', right pill '80% funded'; plain horizontal progress line and '$100.70 remaining'. No picture.

Next row three equal financial cards with labels and exact large amounts: 'Your wallet' '$700.00' small 'Available demo funds'; 'Interest fund' '$200.70' small 'Reserved for future interest'; 'Interest paid' '$99.30' small 'Across 3 simulated months'. Simple fine outline icons.

Next row left larger funding card title 'Keep their progress growing', short explanation 'Move money from your wallet into the interest fund.', label 'Amount to reserve', input '$100.00', primary button 'Fund interest pool', quiet secondary '+ Add demo funds'. Right next payment card 'Next monthly payment', '$39.93', sage status 'Covered', formula '$399.30 × 10%', text 'Paid from your interest fund at the next month boundary.' Separated note with small information icon 'A month is skipped if the fund cannot cover the full payment.' No claim this is bank interest.

Bottom left growth chart 'Savings growth', smooth forest line actual points Start $300, M1 $330, M2 $363, M3 $399.30, thin grid and pale sage area. Bottom right compact table 'Recent activity' with columns 'Description' 'Month' 'Amount', rows 'Interest payment' '3' '$36.30', 'Interest payment' '2' '$33.00', 'Interest payment' '1' '$30.00'. Footer small fund-accounting caption 'Initially reserved $300.00 · Paid $99.30 · Remaining $200.70'. Slim bottom simulation strip shared style 'SIMULATION', 'Month 3', 'Paused', 'Play', '10s / month', 'Next month in 10s'. Very bottom subtle 'Simulated money · Parent-funded learning rate'. Keep all content within screen with deliberate whitespace. Exact currency values, no duplicate weird labels, no cartoon imagery or novelty headings.
